title: An Efficient Analysis Approach for Multi-Core System Tracing Data

publication.venue: 16th IASTED International Conference on Software Engineering and Applications (SEA 2012)

abstract: The publisher abstract describes a stateful trace-analysis and abstraction approach for parallel processes. It claims that sharing common information can reduce computation and storage compared with stateless approaches.

summary.core_contribution: The publisher abstract presents stateful trace analysis and abstraction for parallel-process traces, with shared computation and storage for recurring information.
summary.problem: The abstract frames stateless analysis of multi-core traces as costly when repeated information is recomputed or stored independently.
summary.method: Only the abstract-level description is verified: stateful trace analysis, abstraction, pattern support, and sharing of common information. The tracer, event set, data structure, and evaluation setup remain unverified.
summary.findings: The abstract reports a qualitative computation- and storage-efficiency advantage over stateless approaches; no numeric result or workload was accessible.
